# `skill`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] skill`

List or load project/user skills. Prefer `read skill://<name>` for the body; `action=list` shows names and descriptions only.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `list`, `load` | yes | Action: 'list' shows all available skills, 'load' loads a specific skill by name |
| `name` | string | no | Name of the skill to load (required when action is 'load') |
